text: Our nation's youth are being brainwashed by social media platforms that are rotting their brains and destroying the fabric of society. When I was growing up, kids played outside and learned respect for their elders — and we turned out just fine. But instead of addressing this crisis, politicians like Senator Davis — who can barely figure out how to unmute himself on a video call — are busy arguing about infrastructure spending. Nobody is talking about the fact that teen depression has skyrocketed 400% since smartphones became ubiquitous. If we don't ban social media for minors right now, we will lose an entire generation to digital addiction and despair.
